description_en: Performs operations on tasks. Currently, only modifying the task execution time is supported
description_zh: 进行任务操作，当前支持修改任务执行时间点
name: ModifyTaskInfo

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instance
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The task ID. Separate multiple task IDs with commas (,). You can specify up to 30 task IDs
parameters.help_zh: 任务ID，如需查询多个请用英文逗号（,）分隔，最多支持30个
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the current execution step. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2400077.html operation to query the current execution step of a specified task. A common value is do_pause, which indicates that the task is waiting to be executed at a preset time
parameters.help_zh: 当前执行的步骤名。您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2400077.html查询指定任务ID当前的执行步骤。常见取值**do_pause**表示等待预设时间执行
parameters.name: step_name

parameters.help_en: The operation name. Valid value: modifySwitchTime, which indicates modifying the switchover time or recovery time
parameters.help_zh: 操作名称，当前支持取值modifySwitchTime，表示修改切换时间或恢复时间
parameters.name: task_action

parameters.help_en:
The parameters related to the action, in JSON format.
When TaskAction is set to modifySwitchTime, set this parameter to `{"recoverMode": "xxx", "recoverTime": "xxx"}`.
recoverMode: the task recovery mode. Valid values:
imePoint: executes the task at a specified point in time.
immediate: executes the task immediately.
maintainTime: executes the task during the O&M window.

recoverTime: the specified point in time. The time must be in UTC+0 and follow the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. This parameter is required when recoverMode is set to timePoint
parameters.help_zh:
动作相关的参数，Json格式。
当TaskAction取值modifySwitchTime时，本参数ActionParams取值为 `{"recoverMode": "xxx", "recoverTime": "xxx"}`。
recoverMode表示任务恢复模式，取值为：
imePoint：按照指定时间点执行。
immediate: 立即执行。
maintainTime：按照运维时间执行。

recoverTime表示指定的时间点，UTC+0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ，当recoverMode为timePoint时，该参数必填
parameters.name: action_params

ErrorTaskId.description_en: The ID of the failed task. This parameter is returned upon the first task failure
ErrorTaskId.description_zh: 失败的任务ID，遇到一个失败即返回
